name: The Ritz-Carlton Rancho Mirage
positioning: Desert resort in Rancho Mirage, official name The Ritz-Carlton, Rancho Mirage, overlooking the Coachella Valley and the San Jacinto Mountain Range, with a hillside spa and a cliff-top steakhouse
best_for: Travelers who want a Palm Springs area resort with valley and mountain views
Groups or families wanting a suite with a chef's kitchen
Guests who want a hillside spa and steakhouse dinner on site

facts.text: The resort overlooks Palm Springs, the Coachella Valley and the San Jacinto Mountain Range.
The Edge Steakhouse is set on a cliff above the Coachella Valley and serves steaks, seafood and craft cocktails.
State Fare Bar & Kitchen serves a menu of seasonal ingredients alongside offerings from local wineries and small-batch distilleries.
Air Pool Bar serves made-to-order burgers, salads and cocktails by the hotel pool.
The pool area offers VIP-style cabanas for private dining.
The One Bedroom Vista Residential Suite has a chef's kitchen with Wolf and Viking appliances.
Select Vista Residential Suites have private backyard spaces.
Club Lounge access is included with Vista Suites and The Ritz-Carlton Suites.
The spa is set into the hillside with views over the valley.
The spa menu uses indigenous botanicals in massages, facials and body treatments.
In 2025 the property completed a two-year overhaul that updated the guest rooms, dining venues and poolscapes.

highlights.text: The Edge Steakhouse sits on a cliff above the Coachella Valley, serving steaks, seafood and craft cocktails.
The Vista Residential Suites page describes a private suite with a plunge pool or fire pit.
Guests at The Edge Steakhouse receive a complimentary welcome drink, The Edge old-fashioned, smoked under a cloche.
The spa is set into the hillside with views over the valley.
The Club Lounge holds an art collection by Dawson Cole Fine Art, with works by Timothy Mulligan.

considerations.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite status does not include it.
The hotel does not provide shuttle service from the airports.
WhataHotel notes the desert location may be warm during summer months.
